service.description: The current user's voicemail in folder inbox (the default) or trash, newest first, a page at a time; heard: unheard or heard to filter. Each {voicemailId, fromNumber, fromName, receivedDate, durationMs, heard, folder, status (stored, audioFailed), hasAudio, transcriptStatus (pending, done, failed or empty), transcriptSnippet}. unheardCount is the inbox's unheard; hasBox false until the user has a box.
The current user's unheard voicemail in the inbox (for Home and the Calls tab).
One of the current user's voicemail, with its transcript: transcriptText, transcriptError (why it failed), canRetryTranscript, transcribeOn. Anyone else's, or one not there: reasonCode notFound.
The audio of one of the current user's voicemail, for a transition to send: location, contentType (audio/ogg), fileName. Anyone else's: reasonCode notFound, the same as one not there.
Mark one of the current user's voicemail heard (heard true, the default) or unheard.
Delete one of the current user's voicemail: from the inbox it goes to the trash (trashed); from the trash it is gone, with its audio and transcript (deleted).
Move one of the current user's voicemail from the trash back to the inbox.
Delete everything in the current user's voicemail trash (their own box's and, V3, their ring groups' boxes'), audio and transcripts too.

Transcribe one of the current user's voicemail again after its transcription failed (or never ran): the transcript goes back to pending and the job runs after the commit. Refused while voicemail_transcribe is off (transcriptionOff), for a voicemail without audio (noAudio) or one transcribed or pending (notFailed).

The current user's voicemail settings: box {hasPin, hasGreeting, greetingContentType, greetingDurationMs, notifyEmail, attachAudio, attachTranscript, rings} (the defaults before they have a box), their numbers (myNumberList) and the access numbers (accessNumberList), ringSeconds (call_ring_seconds, used with no rings), ringSecondsEach, maxRings, maxSeconds (the longest message), transcribeOn and pinMinDigits (the fewest digits a new PIN has). With ringGroupId, the box of that ring group (voice admins only) and maxSeconds and transcribeOn.

parameter.name: ringGroupId
parameter.description: A ring group's box in place of the user's own: for voice admins (VoiceAdmin) only, another user gets notFound; made on first use

service.description: The current user's voicemail notices and rings: notifyEmail (empty: no email), attachAudio and attachTranscript (each off unless set, and only with an address), rings (1 to 10, empty for call_ring_seconds). Turning an attachment on answers a warning: mail cannot be recalled. With ringGroupId, the ring group's box (voice admins only; it has no rings of its own: the group rings by its seconds).

parameter.name: ringGroupId
parameter.description: A ring group's box in place of the user's own: for voice admins (VoiceAdmin) only, another user gets notFound; made on first use

service.description: Set or change the current user's voicemail PIN (voicemail_pin_min_digits, 6 by default, to 12 digits, not one digit repeated or a run like 123456), kept as an argon2 hash; clear true removes it (no phone access). Setting one clears the box's failed tries.

The current user's greeting, recorded in the browser or uploaded: a WAV (16-bit PCM) or Ogg Opus file of at most 10 MB and a minute. It is converted to Ogg Opus (convert#GreetingAudio) in a build with phone calls, else kept as uploaded. Audio that does not read: reasonCode badAudio. With ringGroupId, the ring group's greeting (voice admins only).

parameter.name: ringGroupId
parameter.description: A ring group's box in place of the user's own: for voice admins (VoiceAdmin) only, another user gets notFound; made on first use

service.description: Remove the current user's greeting, or with ringGroupId the ring group's (voice admins only): callers hear the default one.

parameter.name: ringGroupId
parameter.description: A ring group's box in place of the user's own: for voice admins (VoiceAdmin) only, another user gets notFound; made on first use

service.description: The current user's greeting for a transition to send, or with ringGroupId the ring group's (voice admins only): location and contentType; none: notFound.

Internal (VoiceServices receive#PhoneCall): busy when the user is in a call (UserStatus.inCall: the caller goes straight to voicemail), voicemailSeconds (the box's rings, 6 seconds each, else call_ring_seconds) and ringExpireSeconds (a little longer, for expire#Calls).

Internal (the SIP engine): an inbound call goes to voicemail, reason noAnswer, busy, declined or access (the access number). The call moves there (CallServices, Calls.js phoneToVoicemail: the users rung missed it) and the answer is mode deposit with the box of the user it rang (made with the defaults when they have none): its greetingLocation, hasPin, maxSeconds (voicemail_max_seconds), and the caller's fromNumber and fromName; or mode access. V3: a call with a handling plan (CallHandlingServices, CallRoute) goes to its next step instead when it has one: mode ring with ringSeconds (a ring group's next member, a forward; the engine rings on with a new timer), or the plan's box (a ring group's shares it among its members); noRoute when the plan ends with no box (the call ends). Refused (reasonCode) when the call has ended, someone answered it (answered) or it is not an inbound phone call (notFound); stale when stepToken, the step the engine's timer or the voicemail control came from, is not the plan's current one (the plan moved on; nothing changes). A ring answer carries its step's stepToken.

Internal (the SIP engine): the message a caller left, spooled at tempPath (runtime/tmp/voicemail), as a Voicemail in the box's inbox with its audio at dbresource://moqui/call/voicemail/(box)/(voicemail).ogg. Audio that does not store leaves the message without it (status audioFailed, lastErrorText). Then the owner is told (a chatUser push and Web Push "New voicemail from ..."), the transcription is queued when voicemail_transcribe is on, and the email notice when the box has notifyEmail.

parameter.name: fromLocation
parameter.description: A message the edge node recorded, as this node's queue kept it (receive#EdgeVoicemail, E8)

parameter.name: receivedDate
parameter.description: When the caller left it; now when empty

service.description: Internal: moves the SIP engine's spooled message (tempPath, which must be under the runtime's tmp/voicemail) to contentLocation (under dbresource://moqui/call/voicemail/) and deletes the spooled file; an empty contentLocation only deletes it. byteSize is what was stored. A path outside the spool, or a location outside the voicemail root, is refused. Or, on a local node, a message its edge node's SIP engine recorded (fromLocation, where this node's queue kept the item's content, under dbresource://moqui/edge/content/in/; E8), copied to contentLocation; the queue removes its copy.

On a local node, the edge link's queue kind voicemail (plans/archive/Edge-Node.md §5.4 "Voice (SIP)", E8): a message the SIP engine of its edge node recorded, the item's content. The payload names the number called (toNumber), the caller (fromNumber, fromName), its length (durationMs) and when it came (receivedMs), and callSessionId when this node had routed the call (its box is the one begin#Voicemail chose for it); with none, or for a call whose media is not on the edge node, the box is the number's own again (the user's, or the ring group's fallback box, made when there is none), whatever the edge node says. Then store#Voicemail, with the owner's notices. Run only for the queue, as _edge_; a number with no box here is logged and the item applied with no message.

Internal (the SIP engine of this node's edge node, E8): the audio of a message it is to play over the phone (audioLocation, from check#VoicemailPin's messageList), as audioBase64, only for a call (callSessionId) whose caller gave that message's box's PIN (CallSession.voicemailAccessBoxId) and that has not ended; nothing otherwise (notFound).

Internal (store#VoicemailGreeting): the audio at sourceLocation (WAV 16-bit PCM or Ogg Opus, a minute at most is kept) as Ogg Opus at targetLocation, both under dbresource://moqui/call/voicemail/greeting/; durationMs. Audio that does not read is an answer: reasonCode badAudio and errorText. Only in a build with phone calls (the sip feature): elsewhere the call fails and the upload is kept as it is.

Internal (the SIP engine): a PIN entered over the phone for voicemailBoxId (pressing * in the box's greeting) or for the box the number boxNumber rings (the access number). An answer, never an error: accepted with voicemailBoxId and its new messages (messageList: voicemailId, audioLocation, fromNumber, receivedDate, durationMs; oldest first), or not, blocked when the box or the source (fromNumber) is now blocked. Failures are limited per box (5 in 15 minutes, then 15 minutes refused) and per source (10 in an hour, then an hour); a box that does not exist or has no PIN is refused the same way after the same work.

Internal (the SIP engine, after an accepted PIN for voicemailBoxId): op delete (key 7: to the trash), save (key 9: heard) or heard, on a message of that box. From the edge node's delegate user (E8), only on a call (callSessionId) whose caller gave that box's PIN.

Internal (after store#Voicemail and retry#VoicemailTranscript commit): the voicemail's audio to text by SpeechServices.transcribe#Audio, as its owner (purpose voicemail:(voicemailId)), into its CallTranscript: done with the text, or failed with why (the audio is kept). Only while voicemail_transcribe is on (reasonCode transcriptionOff otherwise). The email notice that waits for the transcript goes then.

Internal: the email notice of a new voicemail to its box's notifyEmail (the SYSTEM email server): who, when, how long and a link (comms_app_root, with the webapp host when webapp_http_host is set); the audio attached only with attachAudio, the transcript only with attachTranscript. Once per voicemail.

The voicemail job (daily): messages in a trash longer than voicemail_trash_days (0 keeps them) are deleted with their audio and transcripts, each on its own; failed-PIN counts a day old are deleted (expire#VoicemailPinFailures).
Internal: the VoicemailPinFailure rows (per source, and per box number with no box) whose last failure is a day old, past every window and block.
Internal: one message of expire#VoicemailTrash.
